note: Canonical queries for the frozen benchmark questions. The query shown for each question is the reference compilation used in the paper's evaluation, not a live compilation; execution over the graph is performed in the browser and is deterministic.

questions.question: Show me all glass surfaces in the scene.
Which road surfaces are marked wettable by the rain-exposure model?
What does the graph record about OSM building 915551373, including its components and neighbouring buildings?
Which in-scope surfaces retain an unknown canonical material class?
Which surfaces are affected by the modeled wet state?
Which permittivity and conductivity fields are recorded for glass surfaces at 3.5 GHz?
Show all surfaces whose property confidence is at most 0.5.
Which asphalt road surfaces are classified as wettable?
Which 100-m areas contain the highest density of surfaces with a modeled dry--wet state change?
Rank the top 5 entities whose electromagnetic signature changes most when it rains.
What is the distribution of surface types (wall, roof, window, road, ...)?
For how many surfaces does the permittivity come from the scene catalogue rather than a class default?
Which surfaces are currently hidden behind scaffolding?

query.reason: The graph has no live camera or visual-observation data; it cannot report what is currently visible on site.

questions.question: Which surfaces show cracks in the most recent real-world image?

query.reason: The graph has no real-world imagery or damage-state attribute for any surface.

questions.question: Return the dry-state radio-material parameters for plastered walls at 2.4 GHz.
Which roof or road surfaces change their radio-material parameters between dry and wet states?
Show roof surfaces ordered by material-derived LiDAR pseudo-reflectance, lowest first.
Which evaluated roof and road surfaces have a label-supported parent link?
